sentences.en: An oculist doesn't make ocular prosthetics; that's an ocularist.
sentences.zh: 眼科医生并不制作眼罩；那是眼罩技师的工作。

sentences.en: L. L. Zamenhof was a Jewish oculist.
sentences.zh: L. L. 坎门霍夫是一位犹太眼科医生。

sentences.en: He visited the oculist because his eyes were feeling very dry.
sentences.zh: 他去看眼科医生，因为眼睛感觉很干涩。
